posteriores.texto: E o senhor de José o tomou, e o entregou na casa do cárcere, no lugar onde os presos do rei estavam encarcerados; e ali ficou, na casa do cárcere.
O SENHOR, porém, era com José, e estendeu sobre ele a sua misericórdia, e deu-lhe graça aos olhos do carcereiro-mor.

kjv.texto: And it came to pass, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spake unto him, saying, After this manner did thy servant to me; that his wrath was kindled.

vizinhos.18: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.
vizinhos.20: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.
